import hashlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from delivery_audit import audit as audit_delivery
from branch_comparison_audit import audit as audit_pair

left, right = (Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]))
comparison_id, left_id, right_id = sys.argv[3:6]
for root, expected in ((left, left_id), (right, right_id)):
    assert json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text())["selected_case_id"] == expected
    assert audit_delivery(root)["delivery_physical_audit_passed"] is True
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=".runtime-work", prefix="c126120-pair-") as temporary:
    packet_paths = []
    for index, root in enumerate((left, right)):
        packet = {"context": json.loads((root / "median-context.json").read_text()),
                  "samples": [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "ego-body-history.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()],
                  "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False}
        target = Path(temporary) / f"source-{index}.json"
        target.write_text(json.dumps(packet, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        packet_paths.append(target)
    digest = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    left_packet, right_packet = packet_paths
    left_config, right_config = left / "config.json", right / "config.json"
    result = audit_pair(comparison_id, left_packet, digest(left_packet),
                        right_packet, digest(right_packet), left_config,
                        digest(left_config), right_config, digest(right_config))
    assert result["case_ids"] == [left_id, right_id]
    print(json.dumps(result))
